high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic scene of three robed figures illuminated by a dramatic light beam.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark, misty, atmospheric environment on a concrete surface with deep blue-gray tones and wisps of fog, shot in a widescreen aspect ratio with black letterboxing.

elements.desc: Three figures in long black robes standing in a line, one in the foreground and two slightly behind.
A bright white beam of light cutting diagonally through the dark atmosphere from the left side of the frame.
